# General 15-nodal quartic K3: exact computation data

This directory archives the official computation data accompanying Igor
Dolgachev and Ichiro Shimada, *15-nodal quartic surfaces. Part II: The
automorphism group*.

- `15nodalcompdata.txt` is the authors' GAP-format exact data, downloaded
  from <https://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/shimada/preprints/15NodalQuart/15nodal/compdata/15nodalcompdata.txt>.
- `15nodalCompData.pdf` is Shimada's official five-page field-by-field
  explanation, downloaded from
  <https://home.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/ichiro-shimada/preprints/15NodalQuart/15nodal/compdatatex/15nodalCompData.pdf>.
- Paper: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.05390>;
  DOI: <https://doi.org/10.1007/s12215-019-00464-7>.

The explanation identifies `GramS15` as the Gram matrix of the rank-16
lattice, `D15WallRecs` as the complete list of 314 induced-chamber walls,
`OS15D15` as all elements of `O(S15,D15)`, and `OS15D15permutation` as the
natural isomorphism `O(S15,D15) ~= S6`.
